summary: electro-optical targeting system: OLS-27 infrared search and track and laser rangefinder

wavelength_min_um.note: Atmospheric MWIR passband lower edge (3.0 um)

wavelength_max_um.note: Atmospheric MWIR passband upper edge (5.0 um)

nei_w_m2.note: Unpublished Noise-Equivalent Irradiance; Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder class estimate (Hudson IR System Engineering bounds)

detection_snr.note: Linear detection SNR threshold (~7.8 dB) for low false-alarm point-target IR/UV detection

lookdown_factor.note: Background-clutter NEI multiplier when looking below horizon against warm Earth/cloud background

azimuth_limit_deg.note: Assumed azimuth field-of-regard half-angle for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder

elevation_min_deg.note: Assumed lower elevation field-of-regard limit for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder

elevation_max_deg.note: Assumed upper elevation field-of-regard limit for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder

angle_sigma_mrad.note: Unpublished angular measurement 1-sigma at threshold for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder

angle_floor_mrad.note: Unpublished high-SNR stabilized angular error floor for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder

measure_s.note: Nominal optical frame/scan track update period

memory_s.note: Optical track coast memory during temporary cloud/aspect occultation

continuous.note: Requires explicit Search or Track tasking

laser_wavelength_um.note: Standard Nd:YAG 1.064 um military LRF/LTD wavelength

laser_peak_power_w.note: Unpublished pulsed LRF peak optical power; Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder class estimate

laser_aperture_m.note: Assumed laser receiver optical aperture diameter for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder

laser_nep_w.note: Assumed APD/InGaAs laser receiver noise-equivalent power

laser_max_range_m.note: Assumed instrumented maximum laser ranging envelope for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder

laser_range_sigma_m.note: Assumed 1-sigma pulsed LRF range measurement uncertainty for Su-27S OLS-27 MWIR fighter IRST + laser rangefinder
